On that date PT is still on daylight time (PDT, UTC‑7).  
10:00 AM PDT = 17:00 UTC.  

Spain switches from CEST (UTC+2) to CET (UTC+1) on the night of 2026‑10‑25, so on 2026‑10‑26 and thereafter Madrid is on CET (UTC+1).  

17:00 UTC + 1 hour = 18:00 CET on 2026‑10‑26.  

Adding the 72‑hour window gives the same clock time three days later: 2026‑10‑29 18:00 CET.
